visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized anime sequence showing a close-up of a clenched fist resting on a wooden floor, followed by an animated blue character with exaggerated dark circles under its eyes appearing against a plain white background. (2) A cartoon avatar of a young man with black hair, wearing a gray t-shirt, appears in the center, holding a red steaming coffee cup and pointing upward while gesturing. (3) The visuals transition to simple infographic-style animations including two stick figures (one yellow, one green), a character sleeping in a blue bed, and a cheerful anime-style girl waking up happily in a sunlit bedroom. (4) A scene depicts a green character confined behind metal bars with a ticking clock, next to the text '32 hours', followed by a sequence showing characters looking at a tablet screen with varying surprised and neutral expressions. (5) A pink brain character holding a wooden spear appears with an angry facial expression to represent the nervous system's reaction. (6) Two cartoon characters are shown, one laughing intensely and slapping the other's shoulder. The video concludes with a brand logo animation featuring a round white face with a red cap and the name 'Weisway' in Chinese characters.
